study_card.difficulty: 项目协作 · 词汇主线
study_card.main_practice: 先听故事 · 再跟读 · 最后替换成自己的经历
value_points: 当天 18 个词汇都进入 Alex 的故事
云服务器与容器 × 礼貌表达不同意见 × 发布与版本
study_card.suggested_pace: 先猜大意 · 听读 2 遍 · 遮住中文复述 · 完成输出任务

segments.en: By day 19, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "cloud service" and "virtual server" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "I see your point." and "I have a different view." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "release" and "release note" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.

segments.zh: 第 19 天，Alex 正在帮助完成一个不断扩大的项目。因为项目在成长，Alex 需要向团队解释每一步。开会前，Alex 复习云服务、虚拟服务器，并说明它们为什么重要。当队友询问进展时，Alex 使用我明白你的观点。、我有不同的看法。，让对话保持清楚。会议后，Alex 用发布、发布说明更新项目，并记录下一项行动。团队理解了计划，Alex 也学会了把词汇和真实工作联系起来。

发布，把一个可用版本正式提供给用户
发布说明，介绍新版本的变化

segments.en: By day 19, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "host machine" and "start a container" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "Let's compare the evidence." and "That sounds reasonable." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "pre-release" and "publish a release" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.
